caption: Rocca di San Leo, San Leo
composition: Mountaintop fortress above the Montefeltro village · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The camera faces the Rocca di San Leo from across the valley on a clear morning, the fortress crowning its sheer rock crag at the center of the frame. The stone walls and keep sit atop the pale cliff, with the tiled roofs of the village spilling down the wooded slope at the lower left. Behind it all, the blue ridges of the Montefeltro hills layer into the distance under the modelled 23 September 2026, 08:51 sky, thin cloud drifting high above.
